concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-plugins-adobe-commerce]] — 2026-09-15 Adyen Docs overview of standard versus PWA headless Adobe Commerce plugin integrations, feature/version/support tables, Checkout API/webhook flow and setup routes; major-version guidance must be checked against exact package releases.
warnings: The Docs V11 row says Adobe Commerce 2.4.8 or later, while retained exact adyen/module-payment@11.0.0 GitHub evidence says Magento 2.4.8 only; keep major-line and package-version scope separate.
Feature checkmarks, order-status synchronization and setup navigation do not prove merchant enablement or a live payment/order/refund outcome.
